newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada, Manitoba set C$260 mln farm safety net.
newsitem.headline: Canada, Manitoba set C$260 mln farm safety net.

text.p: A three-year, C$260 million farm safety net agreement for Manitoba farmers was established on Thursday by Agriculture Canada and Manitoba Agriculture.
"The agreement is consistent with the direction established by the federal and provincial governments for national programs," Canadian Agriculture Minister Ralph Goodale said in a statement.

The deal covers whole farm income stabilization rather than coverage of specific farm operations. It includes management and funding of two national programs, a Net Income Stabilization Account and crop insurance.
A third component of the deal includes allied programs specifically designed for Manitoba farm needs, it said.
